Ad revenue falls

Independent producers reported a drop in advertising revenue this autumn. Several studios said brands booked fewer slots per episode, even as the number of people listening stayed steady.

What changed this quarter

To see the change, the producers divided total advertising revenue by the number of slots they sold. One studio used revenue / slots to compare its rates across the last three quarters.

In the clip, an independent producer describes how the studio cut back on freelance editing when two major sponsors paused their campaigns. It kept the same release schedule.

Producers expect bookings to recover in January.
